text:
- Locate red and green first; blocks start separate on table.
- Use the arm named in instruction; if none, either arm may grasp a block body top-down.
- Move red first to table xy=[0,-13]; accept placed_offset <=3 cm, but re-place if larger or if red is not on table.
- Grasp green and place with ref="red_block", relation="on"; never place green by absolute table xy.
- If green place returns OFF_TARGET, recover by placing green on table clear of red, re-grasp, and retry; verify red remains on table.
- Before done, verify green on red, red on table, and all used arms released/home.
goal: Red block on table near center; green block stably on top of red; all used arms released.
